project_type: Python CLI library (package `sars`, distribution `sars-convert`) that converts Mwanza Form Two Mock Assessment result reports. Two paths: (1) conversion path redraws one specific reference PDF faithfully to pure HTML+CSS (19/19 pass, 100% text similarity); (2) templated/data-driven path regenerates a report from extracted DATA only. The templated path is visually low-fidelity and is what this task fixes.
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml; installed editable with `pip install -e '.[dev]'`. Console entry point `sars` maps to sars.cli:main.
test_framework: pytest (tests/test_sars.py: geometry/classify/html_out unit tests + end-to-end fidelity tests that extract & render 'Mwanza School Rank-EDK' and compare tokens).
build_command: . .venv/bin/activate  (venv already created at /projects/sandbox/mussannoni/.venv from ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python with '.[dev]' installed and package editable-installed). No build step; Python package.
verification_instructions: 1) `. .venv/bin/activate`. 2) `sars unpack` (extracts sars.zip into data/sars; already done). 3) `sars data` extracts JSON to output/data. 4) `sars template` regenerates output/template_html + output/template_pdf. 5) `python tools/template_audit.py` reports per-document token completeness (baseline: no value lost 5/19; pagination 8/19; mean document similarity 97.27%). 6) `python tools/compare.py --template` regenerates output/compare/TEMPLATE *.jpg side-by-side (reference left, templated right); inspect for per-cell colour washes, row heights, fonts. 7) `sars all` must still report `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%` (do NOT regress the conversion path). 8) `pytest -q` all green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Committed build artefacts that MUST be regenerated and re-committed after the fix: output/data/*.json (`sars data`), output/template_html/* and output/template_pdf/* (`sars template`), output/compare/TEMPLATE *.jpg (`python tools/compare.py --template`). The conversion-path artefacts output/html, output/pdf, output/compare/<name>.jpg (no TEMPLATE prefix) should be left as-is unless the conversion path is touched (it must not be). data/sars/ is git-ignored and re-extracted from sars.zip.
setup_instructions: Default python3 is pyenv shim 3.11.15 (matches .python-version). A venv exists at .venv with deps installed. Activate with `. .venv/bin/activate` before any sars/pytest/tools command. If .venv is missing, recreate: `~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'`. Run `sars unpack` once to populate data/sars.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. WeasyPrint system libs (Pango/Cairo/HarfBuzz) present and rendering works. Do NOT push or create PRs (orchestrator handles that). Reference PDFs under data/sars/ are read-only ground truth; never modify them. Do NOT regress the conversion path (`sars all` must stay 19/19 100%).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. pyproject enforces ruff (line-length 100; rules E,F,I,UP,B) and black (line-length 100). Run `ruff check` and `black --check` on changed files. Keep the conversion path's 100% text-fidelity guarantee. The templated path's token completeness (template_audit) must not regress and should improve where possible.
key_patterns: ROOT CAUSE of the visual gap: the extractor (src/sars/extract.py:extract_document) produces a presentation-complete model.Document where every model.Cell carries a model.Style (family, size_pt, bold, italic, color, background fill, align, rotation) AND real geometry (Table.row_edges/col_edges -> row_heights/col_widths). The CONVERSION path (src/sars/html_out.py: render_document/render_table/_cell_html + StylePool + DOC_CSS) uses ALL of this: it pools styles into st1..stN classes, emits per-cell background-color, and sets each cell's line-height to the true PDF row pitch (minus BORDER_PT). That is why it is faithful. The TEMPLATED path (src/sars/schema.py + src/sars/templates/*.py) deliberately stores ONLY string data (no style, no geometry) and the templates (templates/base.py TEMPLATE_CSS + schools_rank.py etc.) HARDCODE Arial ~4.9pt, fixed line-height:1.04, and only compute the competency-cell background via sars.competency. Consequences visible in output/compare/TEMPLATE MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK - page 1.jpg: DIVISION PERFORMANCE / SUMMARY / GPA-band colour washes MISSING (white) except the competency column; row pitch too NARROW (table dense, sits in upper page); fonts not matched. FIX APPROACH (honouring the user's 'reproduce each report faithfully on its own terms, do NOT force-fit different reports into one shared abstraction'): carry the recovered per-cell presentation (fill colour, font family/size/weight/italic, text colour, alignment, rotation) and per-row pitch through the schemas into the templates, and emit them the same way html_out.py does (a StylePool of pooled classes + per-cell line-height for row height + per-cell background-color). Competency deterministic colour (sars.competency.background_for) stays only as a fallback where no fill was recovered. Reuse html_out.py's StylePool/DOC_CSS mechanics rather than inventing a parallel one. The extractor already recovers everything needed; the loss is purely in the schema->template hand-off.
